title: Membership in the Euler Liar Subgroup
statement: Let $N$ be a nonzero natural number and let $u$ be a unit modulo $N$. Then $u$ belongs to the Euler liar subgroup precisely when the Jacobi symbol of its residue modulo $N$, viewed in $ br/N br$, equals $u^{(N-1)/2}$ in $ br/N br$.
